title: Minimum Changes To Make Alternating Binary String
summary: Given a string s consisting only of the characters '0' and '1', determine the minimum number of operations needed to make the string alternating.
statement: Given a string s consisting only of the characters '0' and '1', determine the minimum number of operations needed to make the string alternating. An operation consists of changing any '0' to '1' or any '1' to '0'. An alternating string has no two adjacent characters that are the same. For example, "010" is alternating, but "0100" is not.
constraints: s is a nonempty binary string.
Return the fewest character replacements needed to make adjacent characters alternate.
hints: There are only two alternating strings of a fixed length, and their mismatch positions are complementary.
Count mismatches against 0101...; the other target has n-mismatch mismatches.
Every valid alternating result is one of those two targets, so the smaller Hamming distance is optimal.
editorial: Every valid alternating result is one of those two targets, so the smaller Hamming distance is optimal.

tests.explanation: Only the final zero must change to one, so one operation is enough.
Either alternating target differs in two positions.
